COMFORTABLE, PEACEFUL AND SUSTAINABLE
A beautiful, quiet eco-retreat; situated on farmland by the iconic Baldrock
Located just north of the Kaiwaka township, Valley Vista is perfectly placed for all guests. Close to the popular cafes and beaches of Mangawhai, while still being away from all the hustle-bustle, everybody will find something they love in our Kaiwaka accommodation.

ABOUT VALLEY VISTA
Your Hosts, Beth and Barry
We are a retired couple, who escaped the hurly burly of NZ’s largest city. In doing so we found our beautiful piece of land which we would like to share and to offer people a slice of our lifestyle.
We started Valley Vista as an eco-friendly holiday park, with multiple accommodation options, in an ecologically sound manner, where people can relax and unwind from their busy lives.
Our eco-friendly credentials mean you have a guilt free holiday – with solar power, a bio cycle sewage system, complete with wormarator and water from our own tanks. Hear Kiwi calling in the bush in April and May. Learn how the seasons work.
Our accommodation options are varied, ranging from top of the line Glamping to an onsite caravan (the Forget-Me-Not Caravan) and family or backpacker camping.

OUR ACCOMMODATION
Click on the Photos for More Information
Shepherd's Hut
$200 - includes Bed and Breakfast for two.
Dinner components supplied for you to cook for yourself for an extra $20 per person.
This can also be used as a family camping area with room for a tent. Pricing on request.
Beautifully hand crafted from macrocarpa, the Shepherd’s Hut provides a beautiful B&B unit . Nestled into a private nook amongst the native bush, this is a perfect couple’s getaway.
Container Cottage
$130 - includes Bed and Breakfast for two.
Suitable for up to four people, pricing on request.
Dinner components supplied for you to cook for yourself for an extra $20 per person.
Built inside an extra tall re-purposed 40-foot shipping container, the Container Cottage has incredible views over the valley.
Camping, Caravans and More
From $18
We have several sites set up for tents. These are generally close to all the facilities. We also have a parking area for campervans, with options for powered or non-powered sites.
We also have a large amount of land available for vehicles to find their own camping spot. This is ideal for 4wds with roof-top tents!
Standard camping spots also available.
Text or email to enquire about availability
